scenario: End to end: two intermediate-fact fragments emit Step/Consumes into the full build engine; late Products (a.c,b.c,cc) retract each step Blocked (block_tool + block_input, multi-justified). The coalesced Blocked emit must not build a duplicate DS wrapper. After scheduling, working memory holds exactly: BuildRequested, SrcA, SrcB, 2 Step, 2 Output, 2 Consumes, 3 Product, 2 Ready = 14. Orphaned Blocked wrappers leave fact_count at 16.
rules_ds:
schema Product scope logical:
    name:     String key
    pathname: String mutable
    digest:   String mutable
schema Step scope logical:
    id:   String key
    tool: String mutable
    argv: String mutable
schema Output scope logical:
    name:     String key
    step:     String mutable
    pathname: String mutable
schema Consumes scope logical:
    step:    String key
    product: String key
schema Blocked scope logical:
    step: String key
schema Ready scope logical:
    step: String key
schema ActionKey scope logical:
    step: String key
    action_key: String mutable
schema Dispatched scope logical:
    step: String key
schema Running scope logical:
    step: String key
schema StepResult scope logical:
    step: String key
    exit: Int mutable
schema Done scope logical:
    step: String key
schema Failed scope logical:
    step: String key
    exit: Int mutable
schema StepOutput scope logical:
    name:     String key
    step:     String mutable
    pathname: String mutable
    digest:   String mutable
schema Cached scope logical:
    name:     String key
    action_key: String mutable
    pathname: String mutable
    digest:   String mutable
schema Unsatisfiable scope logical:
    name: String key
schema BuildRequested scope logical:
    root: String key
schema BuildOk scope logical:
    root: String key
schema BuildFailed scope logical:
    root: String key
schema SrcA scope logical:
    obj: String key
schema SrcB scope logical:
    obj: String key

service cache.key:
    kwarg step: String
    no response
service exec.run:
    kwarg step: String
    kwarg argv: String
    no response

rule block_tool:
    Step s
    no Product p where p.name == s.tool
->
    emit Blocked logical step: s.id
rule block_input:
    Consumes c
    no Product p where p.name == c.product
->
    emit Blocked logical step: c.step
rule ready:
    Step s
    no Blocked b where b.step == s.id
    no Done d where d.step == s.id
    no Failed f where f.step == s.id
->
    emit Ready logical step: s.id
rule fetch_key:
    Ready r
    no ActionKey k where k.step == r.step
->
    call cache.key step: r.step nocooldown
rule reuse:
    ActionKey k
    Cached c where c.action_key == k.action_key
->
    emit Product logical name: c.name pathname: c.pathname digest: c.digest
    emit Done logical step: k.step
rule run:
    ActionKey k
    no Cached c where c.action_key == k.action_key
    no Dispatched d where d.step == k.step
    Step s where s.id == k.step
->
    call exec.run step: s.id argv: s.argv nocooldown
rule running:
    Dispatched d
    no StepResult sr where sr.step == d.step
->
    emit Running logical step: d.step
rule produce:
    ActionKey k
    StepOutput so where so.step == k.step
->
    emit Product logical name: so.name pathname: so.pathname digest: so.digest
    emit Cached logical name: so.name action_key: k.action_key pathname: so.pathname digest: so.digest
rule succeeded:
    StepResult sr where sr.exit == 0
->
    emit Done logical step: sr.step
rule fail:
    StepResult sr where sr.exit != 0
->
    emit Failed logical step: sr.step exit: sr.exit
rule complete:
    BuildRequested req
    Product p where p.name == req.root
->
    emit BuildOk logical root: req.root
rule abort:
    BuildRequested req
    Failed
->
    emit BuildFailed logical root: req.root
rule unsat_fail:
    BuildRequested req
    Unsatisfiable
->
    emit BuildFailed logical root: req.root
rule seed_a:
    BuildRequested
->
    emit SrcA logical obj: "a.o"
rule seed_b:
    BuildRequested
->
    emit SrcB logical obj: "b.o"
rule compile_a:
    SrcA s
->
    emit Step logical id: s.obj tool: "cc" argv: "cc"
    emit Output logical name: s.obj step: s.obj pathname: s.obj
    emit Consumes logical step: s.obj product: "a.c"
rule compile_b:
    SrcB s
->
    emit Step logical id: s.obj tool: "cc" argv: "cc"
    emit Output logical name: s.obj step: s.obj pathname: s.obj
    emit Consumes logical step: s.obj product: "b.c"
